# Persistence Safety Checklist: PostgreSQL RunRepository

**Purpose**: Review whether Feature 005 requirements are complete, clear, consistent,
measurable, and safe enough for task decomposition and implementation approval,
with emphasis on transaction outcomes, concurrency, tenant isolation, lossless data,
migration recovery, and redaction.
**Created**: 2026-08-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements present for every existing repository operation—Run load, event pagination, command lookup, and atomic commit—including their success, not-found, conflict, corruption, compatibility, and storage-failure outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-017, Contract §Repository Operations]
- [x] CHK002 Are all fields needed to reconstruct Run, RunEvent, CommandReceipt, terminal RunResult, budget usage, applied charges, safe errors, UTC timestamps, and stable references explicitly enumerated in the persistence requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-014, Data Model §Snapshot format version 1]
- [x] CHK003 Is responsibility clearly allocated between the shared 004 invariant contract, adapter validation, and database constraints so none becomes an undocumented second source of lifecycle semantics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-022/FR-023, Plan §Application/domain boundary]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements complete for both event-producing commits and legal zero-event commits, including receipt contents, unchanged Run equality, version behavior, and concurrent coexistence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007/FR-009, Data Model §Atomic Commit Invariants]
- [x] CHK005 Does the requirements set distinguish “no new Decimal precision/scale limit” from unavoidable physical storage exhaustion, including the required error behavior when an otherwise valid value cannot be stored for infrastructure-resource reasons? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014/SC-008, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK006 Are precedence requirements defined when more than one persistence problem is observable at once—for example, incompatible schema plus unavailable storage, or damaged receipt plus missing referenced event? [Gap, Spec §FR-016/FR-017, Contract §Stable Error Contract]

## Concurrency and Idempotency Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the complete decision priority unambiguous for existing-command replay, different-intent conflict, public input validation, expected-version conflict, aggregate validation, and database constraint failure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Contract §commit]
- [x] CHK008 Is “相同规范化意图” tied to the exact existing 004 fingerprint contract, including whether persistence compares only the supplied fingerprint or re-normalizes any command input? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005/FR-006/FR-023]
- [x] CHK009 Are the receipt-first arbitration requirements sufficiently explicit about the immediate command key, deferred ownership relationships, and all-or-nothing behavior if Run/Event validation later fails? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003/FR-015, Plan §Transaction Design]
- [x] CHK010 Are creation races clearly distinguished from updates, including expected version 0, an already-existing Run under a different command, and the safe result required for the losing receipt candidate? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007/FR-008, Data Model §Transaction State Flow]
- [x] CHK011 Is the linearization rule defined when a zero-event command races with a state-changing command, so reviewers can determine which Run snapshot the zero-event receipt is permitted to reference? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007/FR-009, Plan §Test Strategy]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements consistent that global duplicate `event_id`, duplicate per-Run sequence, and wrong tenant/Run ownership all reject the entire commit while disclosing none of the existing event’s ownership or content? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/FR-011/FR-012]
- [x] CHK013 Is numeric ordering for unbounded event sequences defined consistently for cursor comparison, uniqueness, page boundaries, and values beyond the current tail? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013/FR-014, Data Model §run_events/Read Behavior]
- [x] CHK014 Are lock timeout, statement timeout, deadlock, serialization failure, pool timeout, and connection invalidation requirements assigned to stable caller-visible categories without implying an unsafe automatic retry? [Gap, Spec §FR-016/FR-017, Research §Decision 6]

## Failure and Recovery Requirements

- [x] CHK015 Is the boundary between “commit not invoked,” “server explicitly rolled back,” “commit invoked without acknowledgement,” and “commit acknowledged” specified precisely enough to classify every transaction phase? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Failure classification]
- [x] CHK016 Are SQLSTATE `08007` and `40003`, unknown transaction status, and commit-phase disconnect identified as sufficient—but not the only—signals for `commit_outcome_unknown`? [Completeness, Plan §Transaction Design, Contract §Failure classification]
- [x] CHK017 Does the spec define caller obligations after `commit_outcome_unknown`, including a new connection, original `command_id`, identical normalized intent, prohibition on a replacement command ID, and acceptable convergence when no receipt was actually committed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Stable Error Contract]
- [x] CHK018 Are retry requirements explicit for `storage_unavailable`, including whether retries must retain the original command identity and which policy layer—not the repository—owns retry limits/backoff? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Stable Error Contract]
- [x] CHK019 Are atomicity requirements defined for failure after candidate receipt insertion, after Run insertion/update, after Event insertion, and during deferred-constraint evaluation at commit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003/SC-005, Plan §Real PostgreSQL integration tests]
- [x] CHK020 Are recovery requirements explicit that a lost acknowledgement must converge by reading the persisted receipt/event rather than reconstructing a new result from the caller’s candidate objects? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005/FR-016, Contract §find_command/commit]

## Data Integrity and Compatibility Requirements

- [x] CHK021 Is the persistence representation defined for every unbounded Python integer and every Decimal-bearing location, including nested event usage, budget limits, applied charges, result usage, versions, and sequences? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §Modeling Rules/Snapshot format version 1]
- [x] CHK022 Are “无损” and “JSON 值类型不改变” requirements reconciled with the persistence codec’s internal conversion of numeric domain values to strings and reconstruction on read? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014/SC-008, Research §Decision 3]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements present for authoritative-document versus projected-column disagreement, unsupported record format, unknown enum, illegal field combination, missing receipt reference, and malformed JSON? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, Data Model §Read Behavior]
- [x] CHK024 Is the policy for unknown/additive document fields consistent with the rolling-upgrade requirement, including when a new writer may begin emitting a new record format? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019, Data Model §Snapshot format version 1/Migration and Compatibility Lifecycle]
- [x] CHK025 Are Alembic migration revision and application contract version responsibilities separately and unambiguously defined, including which one the application checks and which one release/CI checks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018/FR-019, Plan §Migration and Rollback Plan]
- [x] CHK026 Are partially applied migration, missing compatibility row, older/newer contract version, and reachable empty database outcomes all specified as fail-closed compatibility cases rather than automatic repair? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017/FR-018/FR-019, Contract §Schema Compatibility Contract]
- [x] CHK027 Are expand/contract compatibility requirements complete for nullable/default-safe additions, old-reader/new-writer coexistence, backfill, draining old replicas, destructive constraint changes, and contract-version advancement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Research §Decision 7]

## Migration, Rollback, and Data Safety

- [x] CHK028 Is the destructive nature and allowed environment of the initial `downgrade base` requirement unmistakable, including how the target is identified as disposable before deletion? [Safety Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Migration and Rollback Plan, Quickstart §8]
- [x] CHK029 Are production data-preserving rollback requirements separated from disposable downgrade, with objective backup validation, restore-to-new-database, application compatibility verification, and controlled cutover criteria? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019/SC-009, Plan §Migration and Rollback Plan]
- [x] CHK030 Are backup scheduling, PITR, database provisioning, credentials, role creation, and retention explicitly classified as environmental dependencies or future scope rather than silently assumed deliverables? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Migration and Rollback Plan/Security and Observability]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements clear that application construction, API startup, and future Worker startup perform no create, upgrade, stamp, repair, or concurrent DDL? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018/SC-009, Contract §Schema Compatibility Contract]

## Tenant Isolation and Sensitive Data

- [x] CHK032 Are tenant predicates required for every Run, Event, and Receipt read/write path—including replay event lookup and global-event conflict handling—rather than only for primary Run queries? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §Read Behavior]
- [x] CHK033 Are cross-tenant and non-existent outcomes required to be indistinguishable for Run load, event stream existence, command lookup, conflicts, and errors, with no leakage through timing-sensitive content or diagnostic fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006/FR-012/SC-006]
- [x] CHK034 Is the safe public shape of all four repository errors specified, including allowed correlation data and whether tenant/run identifiers may appear in messages, `repr`, logs, or exception chaining? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017/SC-010, Contract §Stable Error Contract/Observability Contract]
- [x] CHK035 Are the allowed structured diagnostic fields and prohibited sensitive fields consistent across the spec, contract, engine configuration, migration failures, constraint failures, and codec failures? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017/SC-010, Plan §Security and Observability]
- [x] CHK036 Are requirements defined for secret-safe handling of both application and migration DSNs without making production role provisioning part of Feature 005? [Completeness, Contract §Assembly and Configuration, Plan §Security and Observability]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality and Scope

- [x] CHK037 Are SC-003 and SC-004 precise about group size, connection independence, request distribution, actual-state-change counting, and how legal zero-event receipts are excluded from the state-changing single-winner metric? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003/SC-004]
- [x] CHK038 Is SC-005 objectively reproducible for all three failure windows, including the distinction between real PostgreSQL commit behavior and the controlled lost-acknowledgement seam? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Failure migration recovery and performance tests]
- [x] CHK039 Does SC-008 define representative extreme Decimal/counter samples and equality criteria strongly enough to detect rounding, numeric value loss, reconstructed JSON type change, new semantic range rejection, and record-format corruption while allowing 004 canonical spelling? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Data Model §Modeling Rules]
- [x] CHK040 Does SC-011 define sample count, warm-up, workload mix, database state/size, pool configuration, hardware/container evidence, and percentile calculation well enough for the 100 ms p95 result to be reproducible? [Gap, Spec §SC-011, Quickstart §6]
- [x] CHK041 Are migration acceptance criteria explicit about head state, row/domain equivalence after restore, destructive downgrade data impact, repeated upgrade idempotence, and absence of application-triggered DDL? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Quickstart §3/§8]
- [x] CHK042 Is the “zero new behavior” scope criterion objectively bounded to exclude Worker, lease, Reconciler, Checkpoint, API/SSE, SDK, Model Gateway integration, Tool execution, and background scheduling from every planned source, migration, test, and documentation change? [Scope Consistency, Spec §FR-024/FR-025/SC-012, Plan §Summary/Project Structure]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK043 Is the PostgreSQL 18.x-only compatibility claim, pinned 18.6 test baseline, immutable image digest requirement, and process for adding another supported major documented without implying untested compatibility? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context, Research §Decision 2]
- [x] CHK044 Is the Psycopg binary/LGPL and bundled-native-library decision documented with the required lockfile, SBOM, vulnerability, attribution, and pre-production redistribution review obligations? [Dependency, Constitution §VIII, Research §Decision 1]
- [x] CHK045 Does the task set require an explicit SQL/tenant security review, closure and re-verification of every critical/high finding, and evidence before the drift report can become `ALIGNED`? [Traceability, Constitution §Design Drift Policy, Plan §Security and Observability]
- [x] CHK046 Are PostgreSQL marker ownership and collection-partition assertions explicit enough to prevent real-database tests from leaking into the fast lane or disappearing from the PostgreSQL lane? [Test Gate, Plan §CI lanes, Quickstart §4]
- [x] CHK047 Does SC-008 cross Python's default integer-string conversion boundary for domain counters and nested JSON integers while forbidding a process-wide disable of that safety limit? [Boundary Safety, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Persistence Representation]
